dedupe_keys.name: hokonavi dp pedestrian space network and barrier free facility open data mlit japan

description: The pedestrian navigation data platform Hokonavi DP of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) publishes open data for route guidance in pedestrian spaces. Pedestrian space network data describe walkable routes such as sidewalks as nodes and links with barrier-free attributes such as width, steps and slope, for route search that avoids barriers and for planning the movement of delivery robots and automated wheelchairs; barrier-free facility data describe facilities and equipment such as accessible toilets, lifts and parking. The catalogue held 43 datasets on the day read, mostly networks around stations and districts such as Tokyo, Shinjuku, Ikebukuro, Shin-Yokohama, Kawasaki, Himeji, Aizuwakamatsu and Toei Oedo line stations, following MLIT specifications (July 2024 and March 2018 editions). Coverage is local, in selected districts of Japan. The data are free under the Public Data License 1.0, compatible with CC BY 4.0, and available to download from the CKAN catalogue as ZIP files. Caveats: coverage is limited to districts where data were prepared, and MLIT gives no warranty. It supports accessible evacuation routing, pedestrian flow and emergency response studies around stations. It complements the Japanese public transport open data (ODPT) and is related to the Canadian cycling and pedestrian network databases.
